description: This file defines an immutable Java class `ImmutablePayloadMapping` that implements the `PayloadMapping` interface. The class encapsulates a list of string mappings, provides methods to create instances from a list or JSON array, and supports serialization to JSON. It also overrides `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString` methods for object comparison and representation.

classes.name: ImmutablePayloadMapping
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the PayloadMapping interface, providing storage and conversion of payload mappings.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty PayloadMapping instance.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a PayloadMapping instance from a list of strings.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns the list of string mappings.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the mapping list is empty.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the mappings to a JSON array.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PayloadMapping from a JSON array containing string elements.
